blocks.title: Data Types and Classifications exam shortcuts
items: Law or regulation dictates handling → REGULATED
Protection requirements come from an external rule or standard.
Example: Health records subject to privacy regulation.
The value comes from keeping business information secret.
The information is an original creation with legal or business value.
Use the most restrictive handling for the most sensitive information.
Business cannot operate without it → CRITICAL
Critical data is essential to mission or operations.
blocks.example: Focus on what the scenario is protecting: confidentiality, integrity, access, location, or legal handling requirements.

questions.q: A hospital must protect patient records because privacy law dictates how the data must be handled. Which data type is most directly involved?
questions.explanation: Regulated data is governed by laws, regulations, or industry requirements.

questions.q: A company protects a proprietary manufacturing formula because competitors could gain value from it. Which data type best fits?
questions.explanation: Trade secrets have competitive value because they are kept secret.

questions.q: Company source code and patented designs are examples of what data type?
questions.explanation: Source code, patents, and designs are intellectual property.

questions.q: A file contains attorney-client communications related to litigation. Which data type best fits?
questions.explanation: Attorney-client and litigation records are legal information.

questions.q: Payroll records and banking details fall under which data type?
questions.explanation: Payroll and banking records are financial information.

questions.q: Which classification should generally receive the strongest access and handling controls?
questions.explanation: Restricted data typically represents the highest sensitivity level and strongest control requirements.

questions.q: A press release is approved for unrestricted disclosure. Which classification best fits?
questions.explanation: Public data is approved for unrestricted disclosure.

questions.q: A production database is essential for the company to operate. Which classification best fits?
questions.explanation: Critical data is essential to mission or business operations.
